notes.title: Announcement: Studio Update
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce a new milestone for our studio after a year of silence. During this time, we have been working diligently behind the scenes to bring you an exciting new game - Muse War, a card-based battle game.

MuseWar is our latest release and promises players an incredibly strategic and thrilling gaming experience. In this game, players will assume the role of a mighty warrior wielding a massive sword, utilizing tactics, collecting powerful cards, and engaging in intense battles against other goddesses. We believe that MuseWar will become an addictive game, offering endless fun and challenges to players.

In addition to this exciting new project, we are also excited to introduce MuseWar 2, the next generation of our game. These new projects will feature cutting-edge 3D production technology, providing players with even more realistic and captivating gaming experiences. Our team has been working tirelessly on these projects and we hope to unveil them in the near future, bringing you fresh surprises and innovations.

We would like to express our gratitude to each and every member and partner for their support and trust in our studio. It is your support that enables us to continuously innovate and deliver highly anticipated new games and projects. Moving forward, we will continue to strive and bring you more exciting ventures and games.

If you have any questions or suggestions regarding our new games or any other matters, please feel free to reach out to us. We are eager to maintain close collaboration with you and provide you with the best gaming experience possible.

Once again, we sincerely thank you for your support!

Best regards,

Happy Max Studio Team
